def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    pedestrians = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    entrance = image_patch.find("entrance")
    green_wall = image_patch.find("green wall")

    if not pedestrians or not entrance or not green_wall:
        return []

    entrance_center_x = (entrance.left + entrance.right) / 2
    entrance_center_y = (entrance.lower + entrance.upper) / 2

    green_wall_center_x = (green_wall.left + green_wall.right) / 2
    green_wall_center_y = (green_wall.lower + green_wall.upper) / 2

    near_pedestrians = []
    for pedestrian in pedestrians:
        pedestrian_center_x = (pedestrian.left + pedestrian.right) / 2
        pedestrian_center_y = (pedestrian.lower + pedestrian.upper) / 2

        if abs(pedestrian_center_x - entrance_center_x) < abs(green_wall_center_x - entrance_center_x) and \
           abs(pedestrian_center_y - entrance_center_y) < abs(green_wall_center_y - entrance_center_y):
            near_pedestrians.append(pedestrian)

    return near_pedestrians
